$comment: checkJs over the JUDGE harness's fixture data + its in-page rules entry (issue #358, the tsconfig.renderer.json precedent). fixtures.mjs carries the canned LIST_ENTRIES rows annotated against gui/src ipc.ts's EntryRowView — this program is what makes that annotation a gate, so a contract field rename/addition fails typecheck instead of drifting past the fixture (how issue #84's clientName/projectName went missing there). rules.ts is the esbuild browser-bundle entry (scripts/build-renderer.mjs JUDGE_RULES_OPTIONS) that hands core's matchesQuery/groupEntries/resolveRange to the injected page as window.__CORE__. lib carries DOM (rules.ts speaks window) and types carries node (fixtures.mjs reads the bundle off disk).
